fullPassage: The act of gardening itself is a fantastic form of physical activity. It involves a range of motions, from digging and planting to watering and harvesting. These activities help improve strength, flexibility, and endurance. You might not realize it, but small tasks like weeding or turning compost can burn many calories. Gardening is particularly beneficial for those who find traditional exercise challenging. It's a low-impact way to stay active and fit, making it accessible for people of all ages and physical abilities. Besides physical health, gardening has profound mental health benefits. Tending to plants can be incredibly calming and meditative. It allows you to focus on the present moment, reducing stress and anxiety. The repetitive tasks involved in gardening can induce a state of mindfulness, similar to meditation. Studies have shown that spending time in nature, even in a small garden, can elevate mood, improve cognition, and reduce depression symptoms. The sense of accomplishment from watching your plants grow and thrive can also boost self-esteem and overall well-being.

det.tip: accessible(접근 가능한) ↔ unreachable(접근할 수 없는)

questions.passage:
(A) Gardening involves a wide <u>range</u> of motions, from digging and planting to watering and harvesting.
(B) The hikers admired the snow-capped mountain <u>range</u> that stretched across the horizon.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 range의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 범위/폭 — (B) 산맥: (A)는 'a wide range of motions'로 움직임의 '범위/폭', (B)는 'mountain range'로 '산맥'을 의미하여 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 산맥 — (B) 범위/폭: (A)는 산맥이 아닌 범위
❌ ③ (A) 범위/폭 — (B) 사정거리: (B)는 산 맥락에서 사정거리가 아닌 산맥
❌ ④ (A) 종류 — (B) 산맥: (A)는 종류보다 범위/폭이 적절
det.tip: range: ① (명사) 범위/폭 ② (명사) 산맥 ③ (명사) 사정거리

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a calm mental state achieved by focusing one's awareness on the present moment"

det.korean: mindfulness=마음 챙김 (현재 순간에 대한 인식에 집중하여 얻는 차분한 정신 상태)
det.analysis:
❌ ① anxiety(불안감): 차분한 상태가 아니라 불안한 상태
✅ ② mindfulness: 현재 순간에 대한 인식에 집중하여 얻는 차분한 정신 상태로 영영 정의와 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ endurance(내구력): 지속하는 능력으로 정신 상태가 아님
❌ ④ accomplishment(성취): 이뤄낸 성과이지 정신 상태가 아님
det.tip: mindfulness = 마음 챙김. focusing awareness on the present moment가 핵심

questions.passage: It allows you to focus on the present moment, __________ (reduce) stress and anxiety. The repetitive tasks involved in gardening can induce a state of mindfulness, similar to meditation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 주절(It allows you to focus on the present moment) 뒤에 이어지는 분사구문으로, 능동의 의미이므로 현재분사 reducing이 적절. '~하면서, 그 결과 ~하다'의 의미. reduce → reducing
det.tip: 콤마 뒤 분사구문 = 현재분사(V-ing) — 동시 동작/결과

questions.passage: The repetitive tasks __________ (involve) in gardening can induce a state of mindfulness, similar to meditation. Studies have shown that spending time in nature, even in a small garden, can elevate mood, improve cognition, and reduce depression symptoms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'The repetitive tasks ... in gardening'에서 tasks를 뒤에서 수식하는 분사가 필요. 과업이 '포함되는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 involved가 적절. involve → involved
det.tip: 명사 + 과거분사(p.p.) = 수동으로 명사를 수식 (the tasks involved in ~ = ~에 포함된 과업)

questions.passage: The act of gardening itself is a fantastic form of physical activity. It involves a range of motions, from digging and planting to watering and harvesting. These activities help improve strength, flexibility, and endurance. You might not realize it, but small tasks like weeding or turning compost can burn many calories. Gardening is particularly beneficial for those who find traditional exercise challenging. It's a low-impact way to stay active and fit, making it accessible for people of all ages and physical abilities. Besides physical health, gardening has profound mental health benefits. Tending to plants can be incredibly calming and meditative. It allows you to focus on the present moment, reducing stress and anxiety. The repetitive tasks involved in gardening can induce a state of mindfulness, similar to __________. Studies have shown that spending time in nature, even in a small garden, can elevate mood, improve cognition, and reduce depression symptoms. The sense of accomplishment from watching your plants grow and thrive can also boost self-esteem and overall well-being.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① competition(경쟁): 차분한 마음 돌봄 상태와 상충
❌ ② exhaustion(탈진): 문맥과 무관
✅ ③ meditation: 'can induce a state of mindfulness, similar to meditation'에서 마음 돌봄(mindfulness) 상태가 '명상(meditation)'과 유사하다는 맥락. 차분히 집중하는 상태라는 단서로 추론 가능 ←정답
❌ ④ isolation(고립): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: a state of mindfulness, similar to meditation = 명상과 유사한 마음 돌봄 상태

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① accomplishment: 'The sense of accomplishment from watching your plants grow and thrive can also boost self-esteem'에서 식물이 자라고 번성하는 것을 보며 느끼는 '성취감(accomplishment)'이 자존감을 북돋운다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② disappointment(실망): 자존감을 북돋운다는 긍정적 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ boredom(지루함): 긍정적 결과와 상충

det.tip: the sense of accomplishment = 성취감 → boost self-esteem(자존감을 북돋우다)
